scope: Read-only review of local static configuration and native XP branches. No game code execution, player saves, runtime observation or server verification.

constants.use: float penalty upper clamp / bonus baseline

review.GameManager.dlu: Reads PlayerCombatController.Player.Character._level; subtracts enemy level; returns clamp((XpZeroUnderLevel - difference)/XpZeroUnderLevel, 0, 1). No paragon level used.
review.GameManager.dlt: Inlining repeats the same penalty. If enemy reward is already handled (Enemy offset 0x1d0), uses zero. Otherwise, PlannedXP > 0 at offset 0x1c8 is consumed directly. Otherwise local base XP and bonuses are multiplied by penalty, rounded and clamped to at least 1 before Player.fhf.
review.hc.dvq: Offline helper computes clamp((threshold - player level + map/enemy level)/threshold, 0, 1); applies base XP and supplied bonus, then rounds and clamps to at least 1. Does not establish authoritative online offline rewards.
review.Player.fay: Fetches StatType 41 (XPGain), which is converted to float and used as 1 + XPGain in the local kill branch.
review.MapData.cfv: Uses DifficultyTierConfig.ExpMultiplier; a separate map type branch adds a map field times a clamped integer. Tier multipliers alone do not describe every map type.
review.native_round_helper: Positive midpoint path compares fractional part to 0.5 and tests integer parity before returning or adding 1; consistent with nearest-even rounding. Evidence review only; not native execution.

optimization.objective: actual XP per elapsed minute, including movement, recovery and deaths
optimization.comparison: A is better than B iff XP_A / cycle_time_A > XP_B / cycle_time_B, or use observed total XP / total elapsed time for entire routes.
optimization.conditional_difficulty_break_even: For matching enemy mix, level, bonuses, route density, non-special map rules and local branch, ignoring rounding/minimum: Nightmare beats Normal if total cycle time ratio < 1.5; Inferno1 beats Normal if < 2; Inferno1 beats Nightmare if < 4/3. Not a measured recommendation.
optimization.warning: Same/higher enemy level gives full penalty multiplier, but higher levels can still have larger base XP. No proven globally optimal map or difficulty.

limits: Actual online PlannedXP production, server formula and server updates remain unverified.
Penalty multiplier zero does not imply zero XP in every branch: local minimum is 1, positive PlannedXP bypasses the local formula, already handled enemy reward uses zero.
Do not transfer this rule to other games/builds or to ability/rune XP without tracing their separate call paths.
Rounding, float32 intermediates and minimum XP mean percentage multipliers are not exact integer reward ratios for all inputs.
No gameplay experiment, player snapshot, drop probability, full DPS model or XP/hour benchmark was performed.

reproduction.method: Python standard-library source hashes, exported config/scene link, native PE mapping, method hashes and constants. Semantics were reviewed using existing local Capstone disassembly and Cpp2IL field/address metadata. Hash checks preserve reviewed evidence identity; they do not independently prove semantics.

commands.result: pass; 5 source hashes, 6 native method hashes/PE mappings, 3 constants, release config/scene binding and difficulty XP fields

validation.manual_review: Changed public files use logical source paths and repository-relative document links. No private media, player snapshots, game binaries or raw decompilation exports were added to public files. Native branches and field offsets were reviewed; no behavioral or server test performed.
